content:
Ari: Quick one — Prospect (FinTechCo) asked if we can remove the VPC/on-prem platform fee for their POC. They say 3w but AE later said 60d. Also asking for 24x7 SLA during eval. Thoughts?
Diego: Hard no on unconditional waiver. Ops still needs KMS setup, infra prep. Suggest conditional concession tied to commit or conversion.
Maya: DealDesk rules: platform fee waivers > $75k require SVP. For sub-$50k we can approve credits up to 30% via SalesOps. Need actual dollar math.
Ari: Their roughs: 2 GPUs, ~9k GPU-month each => ~18k/mo. Platform fee on ratecard = $18,000 one-time. They want the one-time gone.
Diego: From infra: if we remove fee we must limit support scope (business hours), lock model/quantization profile, and request acceptance tests. Also need region reservation (US-east).
Paul: Legal: any financial concession needs conditions: complete security questionnaire, explicit POC acceptance criteria, prohibition on production data, and a signed conversion or minimum commit if fee is waived. I'll draft an amendment clause.
Ari: Commercial idea: reduce platform fee to $5k if they sign a 6month committed spend at $12k/mo (72k commit). First 2 months 50% compute credit during POC, business-hours support. If they convert, credit applies to committed spend.
Maya: Finance: 72k commit covers the revenue hit; Finance would accept deferred recognition if signed by quarter close. Need CAF submitted to DealDesk for expedited approval.
Diego: I'll spin up an infra SOW (1 page) outlining install windows, KMS endpoints, rollback plan, and support contacts. We won't do 24x7 for eval unless they pay uplift.
InfraBot: created ticket INC-7012 for on-prem POC prep (:gear:).
Paul: Add legal trigger that revokes any waiver if they use production data or fail to sign conversion within 45 days post-POC.
Ari: Action items: Ari confirm 3w vs 60d with customer; Diego produce 1-pg SOW; Paul draft conditional waiver; Maya route CAF to DealDesk. DealDeskBot: please flag for expedited review when docs attached.
DealDeskBot: flagged for expedited review if SOW, sec questionnaire, and CAF attached.
Ari: I'll push the AE proposal and ping DealDesk. Will update once customer confirms eval length. Short replies after this.
